The '''97R enhanced blaster actuating module''' was a model of [[Actuating module/Legends|blaster actuating module]] available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The module was produced by the company [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], increasing the power and penetration of shots from the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] it was used in.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 97R enhanced blaster actuating module was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]].
